mission: Advance open source by studying public capabilities, measuring gaps, and independently engineering original implementations.
principles: Use public projects as learning references, not as permission to copy protected code or assets.
Prefer clean-room or independently authored implementations when compatibility permits.
Track licenses and attribution for every external dependency.
Record what capability was learned, not merely what repository was observed.
Create DreamCo-owned tests and benchmarks that measure behavior rather than copied implementation details.
After matching an existing capability, define a harder benchmark and attempt to improve it.
Upstream useful improvements to open source when licensing and project policies permit.
music_and_video_goals: improve music structure and arrangement control
improve evaluation quality and human preference correlation
make creative workflows accessible to open-source developers
evidence: Every rebuild should produce implementation evidence, benchmark results, limitations, and provenance metadata.
